choose_language_hint: You can change it any time from the top.
travellers_hint: For each person, add their ticket, passport and visa. A photo or PDF is fine.
reading: Reading the documents… this can take up to a minute.
err_files: Add all three: ticket, passport and visa.
err_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
ready_body: All documents look good for this trip.
fix_body: Some things need attention. They are also added to your checklist.
checklist_saved: Your ticks are saved on this phone and online.
start_over_confirm: Start a new trip? This trip will be removed from this phone.
no_trips_yet: You don't have any trips yet.
auth_have_acct: Already have an account? Sign In
contacts_hint: Who should staff call if you need help? These numbers appear on your I'm Lost card.
err_contacts: Add at least one contact with a name and a phone number. Indian mobile numbers have 10 digits and start with 6, 7, 8 or 9, like 98400 12345; for other countries start with + and the country code.
ai_badge: AI suggestion · confirm on the official website
tap_big: Tap to show in big letters
arrived: You have arrived. Have a good trip!
lost_line: I am travelling for the first time. Please help me.
help_val: Information desk or any staff in uniform
ask_hint: Tap the mic and ask in your language, or type below.
mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. You can type instead.
staff_hint: Say or type what you want to tell staff. We show it in big English letters.
pass_hint: Take a photo of your boarding pass. We explain every part and save your gate and boarding time.
assist_hint: Ask the airport to help you from the entrance to the plane. It is free.
sent_desk: Sent to the airport assist desk.
saved_desk: Request saved. Show this number to airline staff.
no_contacts: No family number yet. Add one in Contacts.
no_voice: This phone cannot read aloud. Show the card instead.
err_auth_email_in_use: This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.
err_auth_invalid: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
err_auth_weak_password: Password is too weak. Please use at least 6 characters.
err_auth_too_many: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
auth_pass_len: Password must be at least 12 characters.
auth_pass_upper: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
auth_pass_lower: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.
auth_pass_num: Password must contain at least one number.
auth_pass_sym: Password must contain at least one symbol.
auth_verify_email_sent: A verification link has been sent to your email. Please verify your email to sign in.
auth_email_not_verified: Your email is not verified. Please check your inbox for the verification link.
auth_phone_desc: Enter your phone number. If you don't have an account, one will be created for you automatically.
docs_found_hint: We found the ticket, passport and visa you uploaded before. Continue with them, or replace any that are wrong or changed.
logout_confirm: Log out? Your trips stay saved. Log in again to see them.
quick_hint: If it is already done, we leave it out of your checklist. You can change your answer here any time.
dup_body: These documents are already in one of your trips. Open that trip instead, so everything stays in one place?
help_intro: Your documents are ready. If you need help at any time, tap the blue Help button at the bottom of the screen. If you are lost, tap the red I'm Lost button.
bag_not_on_ticket: Not printed on your ticket: this is the usual limit. Please confirm with the airline.
help_hint_short: Need help? Use the blue Help button or the red I'm Lost button at the bottom of the screen. Tap here to hear this.
boarding_estimated: Estimated: about 45 minutes before departure. Change it to the time on your boarding pass and tap Save.
wt_hint: A 1-minute tour of how this app works, shown with your own trip.
wt_lang_say: First, pick your language. Every screen and every voice switches to it.
wt_upload_say: Add each traveller with a photo of the ticket, passport and visa. The app reads them for you.
wt_check_say: The app checks names, dates and passport validity, and tells you if anything needs fixing.
wt_contacts_say: Add family numbers, so you can call them with one tap if you need help.
wt_checklist_say: Your to-do list before the flight. Tick each task when it is done.
wt_day_say: At the airport, follow one step at a time. Show the English sentence to staff when you need to.
wt_help_say: Tap Help to ask any question by voice or text, show a sentence to staff, or understand your boarding pass.
wt_lost_say: Tap I'm Lost to show staff a big card with your flight, gate and family numbers.
wt_end_say: That is MyFirstFlight. Have a safe trip!
auth_voice: To sign in, type your phone number with the country code, then tap {send}. We will send you a code by SMS. Or tap {google}.
auth_voice_otp: We sent a code to your phone by SMS. Type the code, then tap {verify}.
fb_title: How was your trip with MyFirstFlight?
fb_hint: Your answer helps us make the app better for other first-time flyers.
fb_comment_ph: What was easy? What was hard?
fb_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback is saved.
lang_voice_hint: Tap the mic and say your language.
lang_voice_fail: Sorry, I could not hear a language. Please try again, or tap your language below.
lang_mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. Please tap your language below.
lang_intro: These languages are available: {list}. Tap your language below, or tap the mic and say it.
story_sub: A short story of your first flight, told aloud in your language. Imagine it is you.
story_end: That is how MyFirstFlightAI looks after you, from home to arrival.
story_1: Imagine your first flight. It begins at home.
story_2: Take a photo of your ticket, your passport and your visa. The app reads them for you.
story_3: Travelling with family? Add each person, with their own papers.
story_4: The app checks every name, passport and visa, at home, days before you reach the airport.
story_5: It tells you what to do on each day before the flight, and reads every step aloud.
story_6: On the day, you set off for the airport.
story_7: At the airport, it shows where to go next, and what to say at every counter.
story_8: If you ever feel lost, one red button shows your details to any staff member.
err_auth_verify: We could not send a code to this number right now. Please check the number, or continue with Google.
trip_delete_body: This removes the trip, its documents, checklist and contacts from the app. This cannot be undone.
trip_finish_hint: Finishing moves this trip to Past trips. You can still open it any time.
trip_finished_toast: Trip finished. You will find it under Past trips.
land_title: Your first flight, in your own language.
land_sub: MyFirstFlightAI reads your ticket, passport and visa, checks them at home, and walks you through the airport step by step, out loud.
land_langs_d: Choose yours. Every screen, every step and every answer is in your language, and can be read aloud.
land_s1_d: Take a photo of your ticket, passport and visa. The app reads them for you.
land_s2_d: Names, passport and visa are checked days before the airport, so problems are found early.
land_s3_d: What to do three days before, one day before, and on the day you fly.
land_s4_t: Step by step at the airport
land_s4_d: Where to go next, what staff will ask, and what to say, in English and in your language.
land_s5_d: Feel lost? One red button shows your name, flight and family's number to any staff member.
land_family: Setting it up for your parents?
land_family_d: Sign in on their phone, add their trip, and the app talks them through the rest in their own language.
moment_board: Boarding your flight {flight}. Show your boarding pass at the door.
moment_arrive_any: Your family is waiting for you.
lang_choose_below: Select your language from the languages below: {list}.
err_phone_digits: Please check the number. Indian mobile numbers have 10 digits and start with 6, 7, 8 or 9, like 98765 43210. For other countries, start with + and the country code.
fb_speak_hint: Or tap the mic and say it. Your words appear in the box.
err_check_details: Some details are not right. Please check them and try again.
